POWER MECHANICS — TERMLY EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: POWER MECHANICS
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Careers in Power Mechanics, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Careers in Power Mechanics.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Careers in Power Mechanics.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Careers in Power Mechanics.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Careers in Power Mechanics.

   D. Skip safety briefings for Assembly drawing and Sectioning.

   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Overload every socket
   C. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   D. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun

10. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Keyboard
   B. CPU
   C. Speaker
   D. Monitor
